description: What will the spot rental price for an hour of Nvidia H100 GPU compute average over calendar 2026, versus the roughly $3.20-an-hour peak reached in May 2026?

settles_on: The average spot price, in dollars per H100 GPU-hour, across calendar 2026, compared with the roughly $3.20/hour peak reported for May 2026.
outcomes: Below $1.50 per H100 GPU-hour on average in calendar 2026, well below the ~$3.20 May 2026 peak
$1.50 to below $2.00 per H100 GPU-hour on average in calendar 2026, roughly half the May 2026 peak

$2.50 to below $3.00 per H100 GPU-hour on average in calendar 2026, close to the May 2026 peak
$3.00 or above per H100 GPU-hour on average in calendar 2026, at or above the May 2026 peak
